evidence: Quality-adjusted: **78.7%** of pairs have a path through an intermediate shared by ≤10 targets (67.3% at ≤5, 86.1% at ≤25).
metric: 67.3% (df<=5), 78.7% (df<=10), 86.1% (df<=25) of 15,430; GO 4,003 terms, max 613; phenotype 407, max 553; pathway 1,727, max 430; PPI median degree 5, max 74
observation: Counting only intermediates shared by at most N kinase targets, 10,378 of 15,430 pairs (67.3%) qualify at df<=5, 12,147 (78.7%) at df<=10 and 13,279 (86.1%) at df<=25. Hub terms are why raw coverage overstates quality: GO has 4,003 terms with median 1 target per term but a maximum of 613, phenotype 407 with maximum 553, pathway 1,727 with maximum 430. The explanation policy therefore ranks intermediates by IDF rather than leading with a hub.
subject: F-96
title: Quality-adjusted coverage: 78.7% of pairs have a specific intermediate
